messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: embed-service 95p latency spike > 2s for 5m. paging @oncall (priority: high)
Maya: saw it. waking up. joining call in 2.
Maya: quick check — any recent deploys?
Owen: not by me. last deploy 03:12 by elena/quant-prune (minor). system shows increased queue depth on gtx-pool-2.
Maya: running fast queries: `kubectl top pods -n inference | grep embed-service`
Maya: pods are pegged CPU, instance queue length high. starting emergency scale to +3 replicas now.
ops-bot: scale command executed: `k scale deployment/embed-service --replicas=6 -n inference` (initiated by Maya)
Kai: adding a hot-fallback route to serve smaller model for non-critical namespaces. applying route patch.
Maya: enabling KV-prefix caching for frequent prefixes as a short-term. config snippet: ```PATCH /config/cache
{ "embed-service": { "kv_cache": { "enabled": true, "prefix_ttl": 60 } } }```
Elena: rolling back quant-prune commit as it's suspicious. `git revert ea3f9a` then kicking ci rollback job.
Sam: monitoring customer errors — query to look at 5xx by customer: `select customer_id, count(*) from requests where status like '5%' and svc='embed-service' group by 1`
Zara: brief on-call handoff: Maya, do you want to hand this to ops for steady-state? I'm available to take next shift at 04:10 UTC.
Maya: yes — Owen can take immediate mitigation and continue handoff to Zara at 04:10. Owen, any other blockers?
Owen: have metrics streaming. after scale+fallback, p50 dropped to 220ms but 95p still ~1.3s. retry storms from an upstream batch job look likely. I've paused batch ingestion from partner pipelines.
Elena: rollback completed, CI indicates deploy reverted at 03:28.
Maya: customer impact: Sam do you have counts?
Sam: quick numbers: ~3 enterprise customers (IDs: C-182, C-201, C-338) had 5xx spikes for ~18 minutes during the worst window. ~1.2% overall error rate increase for all embed calls that hour. no data exfiltration.
Maya: notifying support and account teams. posting brief to #support: "embed-service elevated errors 03:12-03:30, mitigated via scale+rollback. contacting affected customers."
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042. Postmortem placeholder: https://pm.redwood/INC-2026-042
Kai: flagging for a postmortem and an eval regression run against the quant-prune branch.
Maya: immediate action items (quick):
- scale replicas (done) — Maya — closed
- enable fallback model — Kai — done
- pause upstream batch — Owen — done
- rollback quant-prune — Elena — done
Maya: longer-term items to track in the postmortem:
- identify root cause: check kernel/kernel-selection impact of quantization on KV cache hit patterns — owner: Elena — target: 2026-04-20
- add autoscale policy for embed-service that considers queue depth not just CPU — owner: Kai — target: 2026-04-15
- improve observability: add per-tenant 95p latency SLI and alert — owner: Sam — target: 2026-04-10
- create regression suite for quant-prune that runs on preflight and nightly — owner: Owen — target: 2026-04-12
Owen: I'll draft the postmortem timeline tonight. can someone own scheduling the review/brown-bag?
Maya: I'll book a 30m postmortem review for next Tue 10:00 PT. adding brown-bag share-out slot for Fri 11:00 PT to walk through prevention patterns.
Zara: can we make the brown-bag focused: "Quantization and Serving: pitfalls and runtime mitigations" — I can present. :thumbsup:
Elena: I'll prepare a short demo of the problematic model artifacts and kernel traces.
Sam: I'll put together the customer impact slide and mitigation timeline.
Kai: I'll propose a code change for autoscale and open a PR draft linked in the postmortem.
Maya: incident-bot created follow-up tasks: TASK-892 (autoscale), TASK-893 (regression suite), TASK-894 (observability), TASK-895 (postmortem doc). assigned to respective owners.
incident-bot: Reminder: on-call handoff at 04:10 UTC. Maya -> Zara.
Maya: handing off to Zara now. summary: scaled, fallback enabled, rollback done, paused upstream batch, customers notified. ongoing: root-cause analysis and postmortem tasks assigned.
Zara: taking handoff. I'll keep the watch and coordinate postmortem logistics.
Owen: quick note: add a mitigation runbook entry for "model-quantization rollback" that includes CLI commands and telemetry checks. owner: Owen — I'll draft.
Elena: small follow-up — blocking issue: some older cached KV entries were invalidated by the quantized kernel path. need to confirm cache key stability. adding to RCA.
Sam: I'm scheduling the postmortem doc draft due date: 2026-04-07. link: https://pm.redwood/INC-2026-042/postmortem-draft
Maya: good. please add action-item tags in the doc (`[ACTION]`) and label severity/impact.
Zara: for the org-wide share, I'll request engineering learning newsletter blurb and ask infra to add the brown-bag to calendar.
Maya: final note: thanks everyone — this was a solid coordination effort. let's close the temporary mitigations by end of day, and meet Tue for the review. :tada:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 status -> mitigated. Postmortem scheduled: 2026-04-14 17:00 UTC. Ticket: https://pm.redwood/INC-2026-042
Owen: adding retrospective items to the oncall checklist: verify fallback routes after deploys, and run quantization eval on canary traffic for 30m post-deploy.
Kai: logging action items in tracker. will update with PR links.
Elena: will upload kernel traces and model artifact diffs to the postmortem doc by EOD.
Sam: support notified customers C-182/C-201/C-338 and escalations closed for now.
Zara: closing handoff thread. I'll update if anything else pops.
Maya: thanks — closing thread after postmortem resource links are in place.
file_notes: Generated thread covers paging, live mitigation, handoff, postmortem scheduling, action items, and org-wide brown-bag follow-up.
